name: Hyundai Marine & Fire Insurance Co., Ltd.
summary: Hyundai Marine & Fire Insurance Co., Ltd. offers a comprehensive array of non-life insurance and related services, operating both domestically in South Korea and across international markets. The company's diverse product lineup includes coverage for motor vehicles and drivers, health and children's plans, property, annuities and savings, fire, marine, accident, engineering projects, workers' compensation, and liability. Additionally, its business activities encompass building and facility management, asset management, investment advisory services, reinsurance brokerage, and claims handling. The firm, which was initially incorporated in 1955, was formerly known as Dongbang Fire & Marine Insurance Co., Ltd. before changing its name to Hyundai Marine & Fire Insurance Co., Ltd. in October 1985. Its headquarters are located in Seoul, South Korea.
